name: Frequency Domain Shear-Warp Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that performs the shear transformation of the shear-warp factorization in the frequency domain using the shifting theorem, allowing for arbitrary, view-independent sampling distances along viewing rays via zero-padding interpolation.
summary: Frequency Domain Shear-Warp Volume Rendering decouples sampling density from viewing direction by performing shear transformations in the frequency domain, avoiding large spatial zero-padding.
